I can personally confirm: Uber cash (though it may matter how you buy it), Netflix (US and Belgium), DoorDash gift card, Roku (positive for digital purchases but negative buying the physical stick, though I have seen a DP of physical working), Prime Video rentals, Orange Theory membership or punch cards, Fit Body, local gym.

Lime scooters are super inconsistent. I was reimbursed 12 of 17, with no rhyme or reason between different US and European countries, currencies, amounts, etc. But I generally find both the air and lifestyle credits inconsistent.

I’ve seen positive DPs of: Showtime, HBO Max, Redbox, Vudu, SlingTV, Beach Body, MyFitness Pal, Tonal, Lyft load.

No: Audible, YouTube including TV, anything via Fluz (e.g. Netflix), gyms that code as community centers (supposedly some YMCA do and some don’t, JCC did not work).
